name: architecture-sensitivities-2026-10-31
about: Isolated marginal workload sensitivities for architecture changes since Oct28. Not complete per-seat costs and not current native runtime measurements. No range-streaming bytes or inference costs.

horizon.basis: Full 30-day marginal comparison: fixed cold-reopen days must not be projected from a shorter horizon. Not long-term retention or actual native migration proof.

team.basis: Independent copies of each isolated workload per seat-sized unit; units are synthetic workload instances, not measured people.
